stock.description: InvesTech Holdings Limited operates as a diversified investment holding company, primarily engaged in network system integration, specialized network support services, and the development of mobile software platforms. Its extensive system integration capabilities encompass creating enterprise internet frameworks, high-speed IP bearer network infrastructures, data center and storage solutions, optical transmission networks, wireless coverage plans, application delivery systems, secure interconnection and access monitoring mechanisms, and comprehensive network management programs. The company also delivers a full spectrum of professional network services, covering everything from the initial preparation, planning, and design to the implementation, operation, maintenance, and ongoing optimization of network systems. This includes expert services in network planning, design, and project management, as well as robust maintenance support such as network operations, security management, hosting, performance evaluation, consultation, testing, and integration. Additionally, InvesTech offers smart office software solutions and provides network equipment rental services. The company maintains a global presence, conducting operations in Mainland China, Vietnam, Hong Kong, the United States, and other international markets. Established in Beijing, People's Republic of China, in 1997, the firm adopted its current name, InvesTech Holdings Limited, in June 2016, having previously been known as HL Technology Group Limited.
